description: This header file declares classes and components related to touchpad configuration management within the Cuttlefish project. It defines interfaces for touchpad configuration components, their interactions, and dependency injection components using the Fruit framework.

classes.name: TouchpadsConfigs
classes.description: An interface for sharing touchpad configuration data, allowing retrieval and setting of configurations.

classes.name: TouchpadsConfigsFlag
classes.description: A derived class representing a command-line flag component to parse and manage touchpad configurations.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the configuration component.

methods.name: GetConfigs
methods.description: Returns the current list of touchpad configurations.

methods.name: SetConfigs
methods.description: Sets the list of touchpad configurations.
